blocks.text: Our newest Gemini models deliver next-generation intelligence for agentic workflows and cybersecurity.

blocks.text: Gemini Security Lead, Google DeepMind
blocks.heading: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber

blocks.text: Building on the momentum of 3.7 Flash from three weeks ago and marking our third Flash release in only six weeks, today we’re introducing Gemini 3.8, our best reasoning and coding model yet, at the same speed and low cost of 3.7. Gemini 3.8 introduces 2 variants:
blocks.heading: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash: our most intelligent workhorse model, delivering significant improvements from 3.7 Flash across software engineering, agentic tasks, and critical, multi-step reasoning in specialized domains. It is available at the same introductory price 1 as 3.7 Flash at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens.
blocks.heading: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: our most capable cybersecurity model with frontier-level performance in vulnerability detection and automated patching, available to trusted defenders through our new Fairwind Program .
blocks.heading: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber

blocks.text: While tailored for different deployment environments, both of today's releases are powered by the same foundational intelligence, and further accelerated by long-running agentic loops designed to recursively evaluate and refine the underlying models. The significant coding and reasoning gains across this shared core were driven by a number of innovations, including rigorous training in the highly demanding domain of cybersecurity.
blocks.heading: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash delivers substantial gains from 3.7 Flash, often approaching the performance of higher-cost frontier models.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: On DeepSWE v1.1 (Long-Horizon Software Engineering ) 3.8 Flash outperforms most larger frontier models in autonomously solving complex engineering problems end to end, only at a fraction of the cost.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Additionally, 3.8 Flash exhibits the dependability required for critical enterprise autonomy, across specialized knowledge domains . In quantitative and professional fields that require advanced analysis and reporting, 3.8 Flash outperforms 3.7 Flash and other frontier models in benchmarks like Vals Finance Agent V2 and Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark . 3.8 Flash also achieves a 54.9% on HLE-Verified, demonstrating its ability to handle multi-step reasoning across STEM, humanities, and professional fields.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: These performance gains stem from a core design choice: 3.8 Flash works harder. On complex tasks, it exhibits greater diligence — executing extra reasoning steps, and calling tools iteratively. At times, the model might use more tokens to maximize performance, especially at higher effort levels.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: For applications where compute efficiency is the primary constraint, developers can utilize lower effort levels to minimize token overhead or continue to rely on Gemini 3.7 Flash, which remains fully supported for efficiency-first workloads.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash built this game with a simple prompt using a looping instruction in Google Antigravity. The game uses puzzles, environmental storytelling, and textures generated with Nano Banana to create an immersive 3D level in which you play a wizard navigating a castle.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash builds a fully functional DOS version of Google Maps in a single prompt in Google Antigravity that is fully playable with locations, directions, and Street View.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Explore realtime cross-sections, 2D projections, scientific explanations in a topographic map of famous geographical sites built with Gemini 3.8 Flash in Google Antigravity using real datasets from the U.S. Geological Survey.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Hardware Anatomy is an interactive 3D visualizer built with Gemini 3.8 Flash in Google AI Studio that generates realistic Three.js renderings of physically-proportioned teardowns for hardware devices. It automatically decomposes devices into layers you can explode and inspect with a deconstruction slider.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash: built for long-horizon coding and autonomous agents

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: expert cyber performance
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: expert cyber performance

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, available to a set of trusted defenders via the Fairwind Program , provides a decisive advantage in today’s complex cybersecurity landscape, with the Flash speed and cost that enables quick iteration.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: expert cyber performance

blocks.text: Autonomous vulnerability discovery
blocks.heading: Autonomous vulnerability discovery

blocks.text: On the standard industry benchmark for finding vulnerabilities, CyberGym, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber demonstrates frontier-level performance in autonomous vulnerability discovery. It surpasses both 3.5 Flash Cyber as well as significantly larger frontier models.
blocks.heading: Autonomous vulnerability discovery

blocks.text: To better capture real-world defensive needs which are not limited to just C/C++ codebases like in CyberGym, we also evaluated Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber against a comprehensive internal benchmark in which the model has to discover a wide range of vulnerabilities across complex codebases spanning 20 programming languages. Here, the model showcases an impressive leap over our previous models and reaches a success rate exceeding 70%.
blocks.heading: Autonomous vulnerability discovery

blocks.text: Automated patching
blocks.heading: Automated patching

blocks.text: With Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, we focused specifically on equipping defenders with expert capabilities that give them an advantage over attackers. This is why we have invested in vulnerability fixing from the start, and prioritized it over offensive capabilities like exploitation.
blocks.heading: Automated patching

blocks.text: CWE-Bench , run by Collinear, is a challenging external benchmark for patching capabilities. On this benchmark, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is on the Pareto frontier: with a pass@1 of 47.2% compared to a leading frontier model at 47.8%, yet offered at a significantly lower cost.
blocks.heading: Automated patching

blocks.text: Real-world impact: securing Google’s code
blocks.heading: Real-world impact: securing Google’s code

blocks.text: We’re already using Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber to secure code across Google. For example:
blocks.heading: Real-world impact: securing Google’s code

blocks.text: The Chrome Security team found that 3.8 Flash Cyber produced 2.6 times more correct patches to vulnerabilities in Chrome than the best commercial models that are much larger.
blocks.heading: Real-world impact: securing Google’s code

blocks.text: Wiz found that Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber achieves +7.5-9.7% higher recall on their internal penetration testing benchmark for a 2.3-5.2x lower cost compared to other leading frontier models.
blocks.heading: Real-world impact: securing Google’s code

blocks.text: Google’s Cloud Vulnerability Research team leveraged the 3.8 Flash Cyber model to find a critical foundational vulnerability in less than 2 hours, a vulnerability for which research and discovery usually takes months.
blocks.heading: Real-world impact: securing Google’s code

blocks.text: What our Fairwind Program partners are saying
blocks.heading: What our Fairwind Program partners are saying

blocks.text: Built with safety in mind
blocks.heading: Built with safety in mind

blocks.text: 3.8 Flash ships with safeguards against misuse in the domains of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) and cyber offense, while enabling beneficial use cases, as per our Frontier Safety Framework . 3.8 Flash Cyber ships with a more permissive set of mitigations for cybersecurity, and as such, is only available to trusted defenders who require a more comprehensive set of cyber capabilities.
blocks.heading: Built with safety in mind

blocks.text: Gemini 3.8 models have also made a significant leap in prompt injection robustness as measured by Gray Swan, protecting Gemini model users from prompt-injection related malicious attacks.
blocks.heading: Built with safety in mind

blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber: get started today

blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber: get started today

blocks.text: Enterprises : Access 3.8 Flash in Gemini Enterprise.
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber: get started today

blocks.text: Consumers : 3.8 Flash is available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers across the Gemini app , AI Mode in Google Search and Gemini in Google Sheets .
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber: get started today

blocks.text: Cyber: Through our new Fairwind Program , we’re providing trusted government authorities, as well as critical infrastructure operators and software maintainers with prioritized access to Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber. Apply for access .
blocks.heading: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber: get started today

blocks.text: Introductory price expires on December 31, 2026. Starting January 1, 2027, $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens will apply.
